C_trace_join_contract.shared_fields: Every field shared by the inventory row and trace must agree exactly before combining them; no unchecked dictionary overlay.
C_trace_join_contract.first_legal_divergence_fields: These two fields are taken from COMPLETE.paths, because the original runner writes the trace before adding them to the completion inventory.
C_trace_join_contract.terminal_binding: Decoded terminal metadata and full state identity must agree with the byte-bound joined trace.
